test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Culpable
solution: The correct answer is **"Innocent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Culpable"** means deserving blame or responsible for wrongdoing. (ग़लती के लिए ज़िम्‍मेदार; दोषी) • **Example**: *He was held **culpable**__ for all that had happened.* • **"Innocent"** is the opposite of culpable. • **"Innocent"** means not guilty or free from blame. (जिसने ग़लत काम नहीं किया; निर्दोष, बेगुनाह, बेक़सूर) __ • **Example**: *An **innocent**__ man was arrested by mistake.* • Antonyms are words with opposite meanings, so innocent is the antonym of culpable. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Rigorous"** means strict or demanding. (बहुत सावधानी और बारीकी से किया गया; परिशुद्घ) • **"Reasonable"** means fair or sensible. (उचित व्‍यवहार और विवेकपूर्ण) • **"Edible** means able to be eaten. (खाने योग्‍य, खाने में स्‍वादिष्‍ट और सुरक्षित; खाद्य) 20d:Ta47, The correct answer is **"village from."**
